rationale: Read joins an untrusted name onto root with filepath.Join and opens the result without checking that it stays inside root.
observed_facts: filepath.Join cleans '..' segments, so a name like '../secret.txt' resolves outside root
The joined path is passed straight to os.ReadFile
assumptions: name is attacker-controlled (for example taken from a URL)
suggested_next_steps: Write a test that reads '../secret.txt' relative to a temp root
